messages:
Leah Chen: Hey team — quick heads up, I’m due back next Mon after medical leave but my doctor recommended a 4-week phased return (reduced hours) and an ergonomic keyboard. Is that something People Ops can help put in place? looping @Jamie Ortiz since they’re my manager
Jamie Ortiz: Thanks for letting us know, Leah. Appreciate the heads-up. @Maria Gomez (People Ops) can you advise next steps? I can be flexible on schedule for the first few weeks.
Maria Gomez (People Ops): Hi Leah — we can support a phased return and equipment requests. Two quick asks: 1) can you send the accommodation request form to hr+accomms@redwood.com, and 2) a clinician’s note outlining recommended limitations. We’ll treat docs as confidential.
Leah Chen: Thanks Maria — sending the form today. On the note: my doc recommended 4 hours/day for 2 weeks, then ramp to 6 hours/day for 2 weeks, plus ergonomic keyboard and a standing desk if available.
Eric Patel (Benefits): FYI re: pay — if you’re on short-term disability we need to coordinate with payroll for partial return. If you’re returning full-time but reduced hours temporarily, we typically do an interim accommodation without changing STD. I’ll follow up via DM to confirm pay impacts.
Jamie Ortiz: Proposed schedule I can support:
```
Week 1-2: 10:00–14:00 daily (core overlap)
Week 3-4: 10:00–16:00 with 1h break
Daily check-in 11:00 (15m) with me
```
Is that workable, Leah?
Leah Chen: That looks good. Remote ok for those hours? My specialist recommended minimizing commute for first 2 weeks.
Maria Gomez (People Ops): Remote-first for the initial 2 weeks is reasonable as an accommodation. We'll record a temporary remote work accommodation and revisit at week 3. Please attach the clinician note to the form — that makes the approval faster. Expect a formal response within 7 business days of receiving docs. :white_check_mark:
Samir Shah (Legal): Quick note — treat the medical info as sensitive PII. Keep it in the secure HR inbox only. Managers should avoid storing notes locally. We’ll document the accommodation in a private file.
Leah Chen: Thanks all. I’ve just emailed hr+accomms@redwood.com with the form and the note attached. Appreciate the quick turnaround.
Maria Gomez (People Ops): Got it, Leah — I confirm receipt. We’ll review and post the accommodation notice (private) and cc Jamie on implementation details. If equipment is needed, tag @eng-infra procurement; we can expedite a standing desk/keyboard within 5 business days.
Eric Patel (Benefits): Adding: if payroll adjustments are needed for partial-hour pay, Jamie please submit a temporary schedule change to People Ops payroll queue. I’ll monitor for any STD overlap.
Jamie Ortiz: Will do. One thing — Leah, would you prefer I send calendar holds for your adjusted hours so teammates know availability?
Leah Chen: Yes please, that would help. Thanks everyone. :heart:
Maria Gomez (People Ops): Final note: if anything changes medically please update us. We’ll treat this as a temporary accommodation and reassess before week 5.
Leah Chen: Understood — appreciate the support.
Jamie Ortiz: Thanks team, closing the loop here.
